prompt: Choose the word that best completes the sentence.
context: In the final paragraph the authors ____ that the sample was drawn entirely from one hospital, a limitation they had nowhere mentioned before.
explanation: acknowledge 可以直接接 that 子句（acknowledge that + 子句），不需要先交代對象，而且專指「承認一件自己不太願意承認的事」，正好對應句尾那項先前未提的限制。

distractorExplanations.a: notify 必須先接收訊的人：notify the committee that…，不能直接接 that 子句。
distractorExplanations.b: inform 同樣要求 inform somebody that…，少了受詞就不合語法。
distractorExplanations.d: apprise 的句型是 apprise somebody of something，既要有對象，也要用 of，不接 that 子句。

prompt: Choose the word that best completes the sentence.
context: The board approved the new privacy policy in March, but the regional offices were given until December to ____ it in full.
explanation: 四個選項都與「落實規定」有關，但只有 implement 是及物動詞，可以直接接 it；implement a policy 指把已核定的方案付諸實行。

distractorExplanations.b: comply 是不及物動詞，必須說 comply with the policy。
distractorExplanations.c: conform 要搭配 to：conform to the policy，不能直接接受詞。
distractorExplanations.d: adhere 此義固定用 adhere to something，少了 to 就不成句。

options.text: Our new analyst is extremely comprehensive whenever she reviews a contract.
After three rewrites the instructions were finally comprehensive to a beginner.
He speaks comprehensive English despite having lived abroad for only a year.
The report offers comprehensive coverage of every fund the trustees now hold.

explanation: comprehensive 形容「涵蓋範圍完整、該收的都收進去了」，主語限定為資料、報告、保險這類「內容物」，comprehensive coverage of + 名詞 是標準搭配。

distractorExplanations.a: comprehensive 不形容人做事的態度；形容人仔細要用 thorough 或 meticulous。
distractorExplanations.b: 此處要說的是「看得懂」，應該用 comprehensible to a beginner；comprehensive 不接 to somebody。
distractorExplanations.c: 形容語言說得好要用 fluent 或 clear；comprehensive 不用來評價語言能力。

options.text: The results were clearly bias, so the committee commissioned a second study.
The sample is biased towards respondents who already own a smartphone.
The wording of the question introduced a bias of younger respondents.
A poorly worded question can bias towards the answers that it suggests.

explanation: bias 是名詞，形容詞形式是 biased；描述樣本或資料偏向某一群體時，固定說 be biased towards / against + 名詞。

distractorExplanations.a: be 動詞後面要用形容詞 biased，不能直接放名詞 bias。
distractorExplanations.c: 名詞 bias 後面接的介系詞是 towards、against 或 in favour of，不是 of。
distractorExplanations.d: 作動詞時 bias 是及物的，直接接受詞：can bias the answers，不加 towards。

prompt: Choose the word that best completes the sentence.
context: The emergency rate cut was meant to calm the markets, but by signalling panic it only ____ the sell-off that was already under way.
explanation: exacerbate 的受詞必須是「已經存在而且是負面的」情況，由此把它推得更嚴重；句尾 already under way 明確指出賣壓早已開始，只有 exacerbate 的語意前提相符。

distractorExplanations.a: provoke 指促使某事開始發生，預設該事原本尚未出現，與 already under way 衝突。
distractorExplanations.b: trigger 是「引爆、觸發」，同樣只用於事情的起點，不能用來描述使既有情況惡化。
distractorExplanations.d: instigate 指主動發動、煽動某事，除了同樣要求「尚未開始」，還帶有蓄意策劃的意味。

prompt: Choose the word that best completes the sentence.
context: Economists compare the ____ cost of producing one more unit with the revenue that unit brings in, rather than looking at average cost.
explanation: marginal cost 是經濟學術語，指「再多生產一單位所增加的成本」，與句尾 average cost 形成對照；此處用的是專業術語義，而不是日常的「微小」義。

distractorExplanations.b: minimal cost 是「最低的成本」，說的是金額大小，與「多做一單位的增量」無關，也無法和 average cost 對照。
distractorExplanations.c: incidental costs 指伴隨產生的雜項支出（差旅、手續費），不是增量成本。
distractorExplanations.d: peripheral 指位於邊緣、非核心的事物，不能用來指稱增量。

prompt: Choose the word that best completes the sentence.
context: The second power supply is not an oversight but a ____ component: it does nothing until the first one fails, at which point it keeps the rack alive.
explanation: redundant 在技術語域另有一個正面意思：刻意保留的備援，平時閒置、在主要元件失效時接手。句中 not an oversight but…、until the first one fails 就是這個語意的標記。

distractorExplanations.a: superfluous 只有負面義，指多出來、根本不需要的東西，與句首 not an oversight 的辯護語氣矛盾。
distractorExplanations.b: duplicate 僅說明它是一份相同的複本，沒有「故障時自動頂替」的功能意涵。
distractorExplanations.c: surplus 指數量超出需求的剩餘品（surplus stock），描述的是庫存而非系統設計。

prompt: Choose the word that best completes the sentence.
context: The revised layout proved ____ to first-time users: none of them opened the tutorial, and the support queue shrank by half within a month.
explanation: intuitive 的主語是介面或設計，表示「不必教就會用，因為它照使用者預期的方式運作」，並用 intuitive to somebody 指出對誰而言如此。

distractorExplanations.a: instinctive 描述的是人或動物的本能反應（an instinctive reaction），主語不能是版面設計。
distractorExplanations.c: conspicuous 說的是「顯眼、容易被看見」，與是否容易操作無關。
distractorExplanations.d: perceptive 形容人觀察敏銳（a perceptive reviewer），主語必須是人。

prompt: Choose the word that best completes the sentence.
context: The minister's reply seemed designed to ____ the issue rather than clarify it: every figure was given as a percentage of an unstated total.
explanation: 四個字都與「讓人搞不清楚」有關，但受詞不同：obfuscate 的受詞是「議題、事實、程式碼」這類內容物，obfuscate rather than clarify 更是固定的對比句式。

distractorExplanations.a: mystify 的受詞必須是人（mystified the audience），不能說 mystify the issue。
distractorExplanations.b: bewilder 同樣以人為受詞，而且描述的是聽者的困惑狀態，不是說話者把事情弄糊塗的動作。
distractorExplanations.d: perplex 的受詞也是人，且語氣中性、不含「刻意掩蓋」的指控，與 rather than clarify 的批評語氣不合。

options.text: The biopsy results were equivocal, so the surgeon ordered a second test.
The committee remained equivocal of the evidence presented by both sides.
She gave an equivocal reply that left nobody in any doubt at all.
The equivocal scanner kept rejecting samples that had been correctly labelled.

explanation: equivocal 指「可以有兩種解讀、因此得不出定論」，典型主語就是檢驗或研究的 results；正因為無法定論，後面才需要再做一次檢查。

distractorExplanations.b: 表達「對某事不表明立場」要用 be equivocal about something，介系詞是 about，不是 of。
distractorExplanations.c: equivocal 的回答依定義會留下疑問，與 left nobody in any doubt 自相矛盾，該處應用 unequivocal。
distractorExplanations.d: equivocal 只修飾說法、結果、態度這類可供解讀的對象，機器故障要說 faulty 或 unreliable。
